inputs.text: US-Israel-Iran War. Amid escalating Middle East tensions, the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan. Iran, however, presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression, compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. Israel remains sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict.
